r = await call_tool("list_recently_closed", {"limit": 30})
items = r["items"] if isinstance(r, dict) else r
ids = [t["id"] for t in items]
revs = await asyncio.gather(*[call_tool("list_ticket_reviewers", {"ticket_id": i}) for i in ids])
c = Counter()
for rv in revs:
    lst = rv["items"] if isinstance(rv, dict) and "items" in rv else rv
    for u in set(lst):
        c[u]+=1
top = sorted(c.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))[:3]
return json.dumps({"n": len(ids), "top": top, "closed": [t.get("closed_at") for t in items[:3]]})
